params.name: origin
params.description: Defines the origin location of the requested market rate data. Can be either an IATA airport code or a region as defined in Xeneta's [geo-hierarchy](https://www.xeneta.com/hubfs/2025-air-geo/xeneta-air-geo.html). For example, `PVG` or `east_china_main`.

params.name: destination
params.description: Defines the destination location of the requested market rate data. Can be either an IATA airport code or a region as defined in Xeneta's [geo-hierarchy](https://www.xeneta.com/hubfs/2025-air-geo/xeneta-air-geo.html). For example, `FRA` or `north_europe_main`.

params.name: date_from
params.description: Defines the start date of the date range for the requested market rates in the `YYYY-MM-DD` format. The total range cannot exceed 31 days.

params.name: date_to
params.description: Defines the end date of the date range for the requested market rates in the `YYYY-MM-DD` format. The total range cannot exceed 31 days.

params.name: contract_length
params.description: Defines the type of contract for the requested market rate data. `long` is the only accepted value.

params.name: contracted_within
params.description: Defines the maximum age of the contracts to be included in the requested market rate data, relative to each day. Accepted values include `all` and `3months`.

params.name: weight_bracket
params.description: Defines the weight category of the requested rate data. Accepted values are `less_than_45kg`, `greater_than_45kg`, `greater_than_200kg`, `greater_than_500kg`, and `greater_than_1000kg`.

params.name: service_level
params.description: Defines the service level of the requested rate data. Accepted values are `upper_tier`, `mid_tier`, `lower_tier`, `lower_and_mid_tier`, and `passive`.

items.docs: Returns air freight market rates within the specified parameters.
